behavior: Prefer optional per-frame captureTime, including valid zero, in the browser performance timeline. Malformed, negative, nonfinite or unsafe timing closes capture before encoding and releases its owned track/observer/callback.

When captureTime is unavailable, derive one relative media epoch from the first frame presentationTime and mediaTime; preserve subsequent mediaTime gaps, including pause/resume. Never use delayed callback execution as the epoch. presentationTime denotes browser submission for composition; this fallback does not establish physical sensor capture time.

Four public capture cases cover late first/later callbacks, direct captureTime including zero, eleven unavailable/malformed/unsafe timings with ownership cleanup, and paused callback discard/resume retaining the epoch. No source, observer, AV offset or quality threshold changes.
